title: Reactivation of a Final-Billed Plan after Reinstatement — Installment Payment Plans
content:
A final-billed plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** is reactivated only after the policy term it bills (Owner Auto Policy or Named Non-Owner Policy) has been reinstated; the term's status and reinstatement date in its policy record are the evidence.

On reactivation:

1. the premium re-written by the reinstatement is charged;
2. the reinstatement fee is charged;
3. unbilled installments keep their original due dates and amounts, and an installment whose due date fell inside the lapse is billed on the next invoice;
4. the plan is current.

The reinstatement payment itself must already have covered every past-due amount. A plan in collections or closed is never reactivated.

| Plan status when the term is reinstated (hypothetical) | Reactivated? |
|---|---|
| final-billed | yes |
| in collections | never |
| closed | never |
